rootIdentity.resolution: Root shown runtime immutable PUSH32 embeds beacon, calls implementation selector 0x5c60da1b via STATICCALL then DELEGATECALL with calldata and bubbles returndata. Current beacon getter explicitly returns current implementation, matching explorer proxy link and official Anvil repository. Constructor initial implementation is not substituted for current value.

rootIdentity.caveat: Root shell explorer verification remains null. Metadata source retrieval unavailable; full applicable OZ5.0.1 BeaconProxy and dependencies preserved based on pinned official Anvil dependency and observed immutable-beacon control flow. collateralVaultInitialization.binding: Retained deployment transaction constructor initialization calldata binds this collateral vault; not a fresh live state observation.

sourceSemantics.preconditions: Both selected paths release eligible/reset caller collateral first, reject zero stake amount on chain, pool caller available Anvil collateral using existing allowance and create/increase pool reservation before crediting caller units. No wallet token pull in the admitted path.
sourceSemantics.directStake: stake checks signature.length > 0 before invoking _tryModifyCollateralizableAllowanceWithSignature. Empty raw bytes skips it entirely.
sourceSemantics.selfPool: stakeReleasableTokensFrom calls _pool.releaseEligibleTokens only when _pool != address(this). Exact outer proxy binding makes this false under delegatecall; empty signature independently disables the approval helper.
sourceSemantics.funding: Anvil poolCollateral calls _requireCollateralizableAndDecreaseApprovedAmount then _transferCollateral. Existing caller balance is debited and pool available balance credited; pool reservation debits pool available balance, not caller ERC20 wallet. No new allowance is installed.
sourceSemantics.depositExclusion: depositAndStake cannot satisfy the disabled-authority requirement because mandatory depositFromAccount invokes deposit signature verification, including ERC1271, regardless of bytes length and can increase allowance on success. Catching InvalidSignature in the pool does not eliminate this attempted authority path.

finiteInventory.basis: Every function in the retained exact current implementation fullOriginalAbi; inherited mutable access-control bodies reviewed in the same compiler input. Read-only ABI entries are excluded as no transaction capability. No peer ABI or unobserved upgrade is substituted.

additions.label: Flexa stake existing authorized Anvil collateral
warnings: Static source/ABI capability evidence only, not live authorization, implementation identity, funded execution, solvency, liquidity, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses, bounded canonical calldata, final checks and zero native value remain mandatory.

Mandatory flexa-preauthorized-stake-v1 scope requires raw collateralizableApprovalSignature bytes to be exactly empty; no allowance-signature helper, permit, approval, ledger-operator, role, delegation or presign installation is admitted. Only the two exact source-bound selectors at this Ethereum pool are admitted; no implicit multicall composition.

Funding is the caller’s preexisting available selected-token collateral balance inside Anvil CollateralVault 0x5d2725fde4d7aa3388da4519ac0449cc031d675f, potentially including eligible/reset collateral released first by the fixed pool modifier. Existing caller-to-pool collateralizable token allowance must cover the amount and is decreased, not installed. This path does not pull ERC20 tokens from the wallet or call depositFromAccount.

Amount is positive raw selected-token units, not pool units. The fixed vault must enable that token and approve the pool as collateralizable; existing balance, allowance, reservation and accounting limits remain on-chain preconditions. Staking pools and reserves caller collateral and credits caller pool-accounting units; the unnamed uint256 return is units issued, which need not equal token amount.

There is no minimum-issued-unit or deadline parameter. Integer truncation, diluted pool-unit exchange rates, dust, reset accounting and deposit-size/overflow limits may affect issuance or cause reversion. Collateral backs Flexa payments and is exposed to authorized backstop claims and loss, potentially to zero; no principal, reward or fee guarantee.

Unstaking is a separate epoch-based request, not immediate payout; collateral remains claimable until eligible release. Reset/eligible-release processing can occur before staking. Later release credits the same account inside Anvil; wallet withdrawal is a separate vault operation. Retired Flexa v2, depositAndStake, payment claim, authority setters and pool resets are not admitted.

These are dated observations, not live identity guarantees; the beacon owner may upgrade.

unstake uses caller-owned pool units, not raw AMP token amounts; positive units must be available excluding pending exits. It releases already-eligible collateral first and queues remaining units through the end of the next epoch. Official product describes ordinary 12–24 hour unlocks, not immediate wallet payout.

releaseEligibleTokens is permissionless processing of the specified account’s matured/reset financial ledger, always crediting that same account inside the Anvil collateral vault. It does not transfer to caller or an arbitrary recipient and does not itself withdraw vault tokens to a wallet. Non-matured/empty positions can do nothing.

Collateral remains exposed to authorized payment-backstop claims until released. Exit token amounts are pro-rata from reserved collateral with integer truncation and dust/reset accounting; losses can reduce tokens to zero. No principal/reward/fee guarantee, full migration workflow, active inventory, or ability to bypass existing pool/vault eligibility is asserted.
